image_description: A medium shot of a youth orchestra or band rehearsal. In the foreground, two young men are playing bassoons. The subject on the right is in sharper focus, holding a dark reddish-brown wooden bassoon with silver keys and a curved metal bocal. To his left, another student plays a similar instrument, partially obscured. A third student in a white shirt is visible in the background between them. The background consists of a grey acoustic panel wall.
